what.text: This page follows refugees from North Macedonia in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1886 refugees from North Macedonia, and France hosted 42.5% of them.
After France, the largest hosts are Germany, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for North Macedonia: over the government, with the UCK, in 2001.
The main years of displacement in the data include 2001 to 2002.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1993 at 1895 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 13039, at the end of 1996.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1995 to 1997, 2001 to 2002 and 2005 to 2012.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
